mods.abstract: Phoenix Theatre (a project of Theatre Incorporated), T. Edward Hambleton, Norris Houghton, managing directors, with the Association of Producing Arts presents APA at the Phoenix, "War and Peace," after the novel by Leo Tolstoy, adapted for the stage by Alfred Neumann, Erwin Piscator, Guntram Prufer, English verison by Robert David MacDonald, directed by Ellis Rabb, designed by Peter Wexler, decor by Judith Haugan, costumes designed by Nancy Potts, lighting designed by Gilbert Hemsley.
mods.note: Phoenix Theatre, [March 21-June 17, 1967].
Title devised by Library staff.

Cast: Clayton Corzatte, Donald Moffat, Jennifer Harmon, Sydney Walker, Christine Pickles, Rosemary Harris, Mark White, Joanna Roos, Ronald Bishop, Paul Sparer, Richard Jordan, Gordon Gould, Joseph Bird, Richard Woods, Keene Curtis, John Allan Macunovich, Robert Lumish, Al Hill, Ed Levey, Michael McCarthy, Leonard Peters, David Prass, Barry Bonner, George Addis, Richard Netzband, William Shorr.

LC copy has notations by Coe. Mimeograph typescript slip found with program announcing "A midnight special at the Phoenix," a one man, one act, one hour play by Richard Hepburn called "Washing the Car," at the Phoenix, Friday February 19th, 26th and March 5th [1965]. Accompanied by 2 copies of brochure about the APA, the company members and ticket availability information for upcoming performances of "Man and Superman," by George Bernard Shaw, "Judith," by Jean Giraudoux, and "War and Peace". DLC
In: Richard L. Coe Theater Programs Collection (Library of Congress).

mods.abstract: "The Joseph & Loretta Law Institute of Arts and Technology presents the Denver International Electronic Music Festival 2018 as an inaugural performing arts event. War & peace represents our new and unique Total Music production because it showcases a new concept of total entertainment by immersing the audience in entertaining sounds and rhythm, beautiful and meaningful visual imagery and culturally diverse creative expression. Although traditional music performances are meant to appeal mainly to our auditory sense, Total Music is different because it offers the willingness to combine artistic resources from other cultures with advancing digital technologies in order to create music that impacts our senses in a manner seldom achieved before. War & peace provides the opportunity to push boundaries of musical entertainment by using new combinations of musical instruments, new multicultural art direction and new dance styles. By doing so, an entirely different visual and auditory impace is provided to the audience"--Booklet.
mods.note: produced by Joseph & Loretta Law Institute of Arts and Technology ; conceived, produced & directed by Dennis Law MD.
Title from container.
"A Total Music concert"--Container.
Source used: videodisc container.
Music composed by Jiaojiao Zhou ; costume design, Ah Kuan ; choreography, Chen Jiao.
Vocal artist: Christianna McMullen (coloratura soprano).
Dancers: Chen Jiao, Sun Chenxue, Wang Haiou, Ma Ruhai (martial artist).
Recorded live on February 15, 2018, at the Robert & Judi Newman Center for Performing Arts, University of Denver in Denver, Colorado.
